items.source: If the map is already an AnnotationAttributes instance, it will be cast and returned immediately without creating a new instance. Otherwise a new instance will be created by passing the supplied map to the AnnotationAttributes(Map) constructor.
items.translation: 如果该映射已经是 `AnnotationAttributes` 实例，则将其强制转换并立即返回，而不会创建新实例。否则，将通过将提供的映射传递给 AnnotationAttributes(Map) 构造函数来创建新实例。

items.source: Note: if you expect an actual annotation, invoke getAnnotation(String, Class) instead.
items.translation: 注意：如果您期望获取实际的注解，请调用 getAnnotation(String, Class)。

items.source: If the value stored under the specified attributeName is an instance of AnnotationAttributes, it will be wrapped in a single-element array before returning it.
items.translation: 如果存储在指定 `attributeName` 下的值是 `AnnotationAttributes` 的实例，则在返回之前将其包装为单元素数组。

items.source: Note: if you expect an actual array of annotations, invoke getAnnotationArray(String, Class) instead.
items.translation: 注意：如果您期望获取实际的注解数组，请调用 getAnnotationArray(String, Class)。

items.source: If the value stored under the specified attributeName is an Annotation, it will be wrapped in a single-element array before returning it.
items.translation: 如果存储在指定 `attributeName` 下的值是 `Annotation`，则在返回之前将其包装在单元素数组中。

items.source: If the value stored under the specified attributeName is a string, it will be wrapped in a single-element array before returning it.
items.translation: 如果存储在指定 `attributeName` 下的值是字符串，则在返回之前会将其包装在单元素数组中。

items.source: If the value stored under the specified attributeName is a class, it will be wrapped in a single-element array before returning it.
items.translation: 如果存储在指定 `attributeName` 下的值是一个类，在返回之前它将被包装在一个单元素数组中。

items.source:
Provides 'pseudo-reification' to avoid noisy Map generics in the calling
code as well as convenience methods for looking up annotation attributes
in a type-safe fashion.
items.translation: 提供“伪化”以避免调用代码中嘈杂的 Map 泛型，并提供用于以类型安全方式查找注解属性的便捷方法。
